**0.7.4: No more flicker when Hebrish pastes on KDE.**

- On KDE Plasma 6 (Wayland), the focused window briefly lost focus every time Hebrish pasted, so its title bar flickered. The clipboard is now set without taking focus. GNOME already worked this way.
- Ubuntu 26.04 .deb and a portable Windows zip. Not yet tested on Windows hardware. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
